Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square comic panel for a Chinese Grade 7 classroom fictional teaching example titled "关灯这件事" (no text in image). Clean expressive ink outlines with flat muted colors, warm editorial comic quality, clear readable scene at projector scale.
Night outside an ordinary contemporary Shanghai residential apartment entry. Main character Lin He: 13-year-old Chinese student with short straight black hair, round youthful face, slate-blue zip jacket over a white shirt, dark trousers, white sneakers. Lin He crouches at lower center-left next to the bottom concrete step, noticing that its edge is hidden in the shadow of parked bicycles. At center-right stands neighbor Uncle Chen, about 45, short dark hair, olive jacket, dark trousers, gently holding one practical bicycle. Keep three clearly visible steps, bicycles at side, not blocking the student's face. A tall streetlamp at upper right is switched ON; its light misses the bottom step because bicycle shadows fall over it. The ground remains sufficiently visible to understand the action. In the background upper left, a second-floor bedroom window is noticeably lit by spill from the same streetlamp. The story fact must be visually legible: lamp is ON, bedroom window overly lit, bottom step edge still in shadow. Lin He is looking closely at the step, Uncle Chen points toward it. Natural anatomy with correct hands, feet and bicycle. Single coherent moment and composition. No speech bubbles, no writing, no labels, no numbers, no watermark. Square 1024x1024 composition, full bleed. This panel establishes characters for companion panels.

Use case illustration-story. Reference image establishes the exact recurring character Lin He and comic drawing style. Lin He stands beside the window pulling curtains together but a narrow hard strip of white streetlamp light leaks through and falls brightly across the pillow of a neatly made simple bed. Bedside lamp is OFF. Tired mildly frustrated expression, gaze toward the illuminated pillow. Establish a plausible bedroom layout for reuse at the ending. Cool nighttime blue, controlled warm highlights, clear expressive ink outlines, same mature classroom comic style as reference. The pillow and light leak must be obvious. One moment only. No phone screen writing, no text, no bubbles, no letters, no watermark. Square full bleed.

Use case lighting-weather. This is a deliberate TEACHER SIMULATION of a misleading comic panel, for a before/after lesson about matching a novel. EDIT reference image, changing ONLY lighting on bottom concrete step: make entire bottom step surface, front and edge evenly bright and obvious, remove bicycle shadows from the steps. Keep lamp ON and window lit, same exact composition, camera, both characters' identity clothing facial expressions poses, bicycle, building, ground, trees, same comic style. Result should misleadingly show steps very easy to see, even though student's novel says he cannot see step edges. Preserve all other parts as much as possible. No text, captions, labels or watermark. Square full bleed.
